description: Login with no OS credential store is CREDENTIAL_STORE_UNAVAILABLE before any request; the Action names OPENPROSE_API_KEY. Ported from the account corpus.

problem.action: Set OPENPROSE_API_KEY for this command, or unlock or configure the operating system credential store, then retry.

details.reason: the OS credential store is unavailable; set OPENPROSE_API_KEY for this command

problem.message: The operating system credential store is unavailable.
